name: CUSTODES: CUSTODIAN DREADNOUGHT
description:
The Dreadnoughts of the Custodes are advanced, beautiful machines that wed phenomenal strength and speed with the interred warrior’s own unmatched martial skill. In those isolated cases where a Custodian has sustained irrevocable harm with their mind intact, internment within the cold and unyielding body of a Dreadnought is assured, for no Custodian would tolerate an end to their service short of death.

A Gleaming God of War

This multipart plastic kit builds one Custodian Dreadnought, a mighty war machine for your Legio Custodes armies in games of Warhammer: The Horus Heresy, and for Adeptus Custodes armies in Warhammer 40,000. They excel in melee, where the machine's power combines with the interned Custodian's martial abilities to create an almost unstoppable team. On the front lines and in the thick of the fighting, these gleaming walkers give Custodes armies some serious punching power.

Customise Your Dreadnought

The Contemptor-Achillus Dreadnought is highly customisable and can be built in one of 2 configurations – the spear-carrying Achillus, or the Galatus, equipped with a warblade and praesidium shield. Both patterns are highly poseable. The Achillus has a choice of 2 spear heads, can be armed with a lastrum storm bolter, twin infernus incinerator, or Adrathic combi-destructor on each arm, and has the option of a closed or open left hand.

There are also lots of cosmetic options, including interchangeable helmet sections, 2 sculpted shoulder pad decorations, 2 chest decorations, and optional pteruges, making it easy to customise your devastating walker.

Contents:
– 162 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 60mm Round Base
– 1 Legio Custodes Dreadnought Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Legio Custodes Dreadnought Transfer Sheet features 165 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include Custodian symbols, text for locations of great battles, and more to decorate your miniature.

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Citadel Colour paints
